The Industries We Serve

Where Data Must Stay Secure. Preparation Starts Now

Future quantum computers could threaten some widely used public-key cryptographic systems. We help organisations in these sectors understand where cryptography is used, an important first step towards planning for post-quantum security.

  • Defence communications
  • Banking information
  • Telecommunications
  • Infrastructure systems
  • Long-term sensitive records

We explore this challenge through Sthitha Exodia, an initiative focused on cryptographic visibility, quantum risk awareness and migration planning. Discover. Protect. Migrate.

Understand Post-Quantum Security
See the Whole Picture

Understand Where Cryptography Lives

Cryptographic assets can exist across applications, databases, APIs, cloud environments, networks and identity systems. Understanding these dependencies can help organisations plan their post-quantum migration.
